# SpecimenProcedureStage schemas
{: .no_toc}

Detail schemas for the stages of a procedure or specimen procedure: a phase several materials take part in together, such as the induction of an anesthetic or one bath of a staining protocol.

{: .warning }
> This family is **experimental**: its schemas may change shape between releases without a version bump. Treat writes to these types as experimental.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- These schemas describe JSON fields of the web forms (additional fields, repository links, specifications). The REST API returns the stored JSON as is.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedureStage/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedureStage/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedureStage/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Administration stage

- type code `AdministrationStage` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedureStage/AdministrationStage/1.0.0.json)

Records one stage of a substance delivery to the animal within an administration procedure, such as induction or maintenance of an anesthetic, with route, delivery method, gas concentration, volume, infusion rate and duration.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `route` | Route | choice |  | one of `inhaled`, `ip`, `iv`, `sc`, `im`, `oral`, `topical`, `other` | How this stage's delivery entered the animal; leave empty for a stage that delivered nothing. |
| `deliveryMethod` | Delivery method | choice |  | one of `anesthesia_chamber`, `nose_cone`, `face_mask`, `intubation`, `other` | The apparatus an inhaled stage reached the animal through; leave empty for an injected stage. |
| `gasConcentration` | Gas concentration | quantity with unit |  | units `% v/v`, `ppm`; default `{"unit": "% v/v"}` | The inhaled agent's fraction of the carrier gas during this stage, as set on the vaporizer. |
| `volume` | Volume | quantity with unit |  | units `L`, `mL`, `µL`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | How much formulation was delivered in this stage; an inhaled stage has none. |
| `rate` | Infusion rate | quantity with unit |  | units `L/min`, `mL/min`, `µL/min`; default `{"unit": "mL/min"}` | How fast the formulation was infused in this stage; not the carrier-gas flow, and empty for a bolus. |
| `duration` | Duration | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | How long this stage lasted, which is shorter than the whole event when it ran in several stages. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "route": "inhaled",
    "deliveryMethod": "anesthesia_chamber"
}
```


## Specimen processing stage

- type code `SpecimenProcessingStage` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedureStage/SpecimenProcessingStage/1.0.1.json)

Records one stage of a specimen procedure, such as an incubation or wash, with contact duration and temperature, agitation, number of repeated cycles and bath volume.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `duration` | Applied/contact duration | quantity with unit |  | units `d`, `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | The contact or application duration for this processing stage. |
| `temperature` | Applied/contact temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | The temperature applied or maintained during this processing stage. |
| `agitation` | Agitation | choice |  | one of `static`, `gentle_shaking`, `rotation`, `rocking`, `other` | The agitation mode and setting used during this processing stage. |
| `cycleCount` | Number of repeated cycles | integer |  | ≥ 1 | Number of repeated cycles of the same treatment, e.g., for a wash step. |
| `volume` | Applied/contact bath volume | quantity with unit |  | units `nL`, `µL`, `mL`, `L`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | Total solution volume contacting the target specimens, not stock volume drawn. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "duration": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "min"
    },
    "temperature": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "°C"
    }
}
```
